items.html: *And "the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall" — "Tardemah" has the Gematria of "Targum," for all the Achoraim are in the aspect of the square, as is known; and the sawing was while he still had these Achoraim, called Tardemah, as above; and afterward He brought her face to face. And the matter is that in each of the ten Sefirot of ZA there is one name HVYH, and in its Achoraim it is the Gematria of AB (72), as is known; and behold, ten times 72 is the Gematria of Tardemah, and they are the Gematria of Targum. And all of them are given to Malchut at the time of the sawing. Understand this greatly.
